cases.name: three_struct_tags_on_one_partition
cases.why: `DivergingEpoch`, `CurrentLeader`, and `SnapshotId` are tags 0, 1, and 2 of a partition, all structs. Three struct payloads in one ascending run is the densest tagged section the corpus has.

cases.name: a_message_tag_and_a_partition_tag_in_one_response
cases.why: `NodeEndpoints` is tag 0 of the response while the partition carries tags of its own. Two sections at two nesting depths in one message, each ordered independently.
